faq: Squarespace templates come with your Squarespace plan. The plan, domain and any extensions are paid to Squarespace by you. Our price is for choosing, setting up and styling the template.
Can you help me choose a template?
Yes. Share your business and a few sites you like, and we suggest two or three starting layouts with a short reason for each. You decide, then we begin.
On Squarespace 7.1 you can restyle freely inside your site, and layouts are built from sections you can reorder. That is why we focus on a sensible start, not on locking you in.
Do you add sections the template lacks?
Yes, within the package limits. We build the new section to match the template's style, and count it against your sections-customized limit.
desc:
Squarespace template setup and styling turns a ready-made layout into a site that looks like your brand. Ecom Swift LLC picks the right template with you, applies your logo, fonts and colors, clears the demo content and fills each page with your own words and images.

## What is Squarespace template setup and styling?

Squarespace template setup and styling means taking a pre-designed starting point and shaping it into your own site. The template provides the structure, and we replace its sample text and photos, apply your branding and adjust sections until it fits your business.

It is a practical route for owners who want a polished look without paying for a fully custom design.

## Why a template needs more than a name change

A template looks finished because its demo content is chosen to flatter it. Drop in your own photos and the same layout can look empty or cramped. Long business names break headings, vertical photos crop badly and a button style that suited the demo may not match your logo.

Styling closes that gap. Fonts, colors, spacing and image shapes are tuned so your real content looks as good as the preview did.

## How a well-styled template helps your business

A branded template saves time and money while still giving visitors a professional first impression. Familiar layouts are easy to read, and because templates share the same editor, you can keep updating the site yourself.

Consistent styling also builds recognition. When your fonts, colors and button shapes repeat on every page, visitors begin to associate them with you. A clear form and newsletter sign-up give them an easy way to respond.

## What a properly tailored template includes

- A layout chosen for your type of business and content.
- Your logo placed in the header and footer.
- Fonts and colors set once in site styles.
- Demo text and images fully removed.
- Pages filled with your own content.
- Extra sections added where the template lacks one.
- A contact form and newsletter sign-up.
- Custom button and card styles in the larger package.
- A gallery, blog or shop page if you need one.
- Page titles and descriptions for search.

## What we do

We start by comparing a few templates against your content and recommending one. Then we apply your branding, delete the sample material and build out the pages. If a section you need is missing, we add it using the editor's own blocks.

The Basic package brands a template and fills a few pages. Standard covers more pages, restyled or added sections, a form, a sign-up and header and footer changes. Premium reshapes the template until it feels custom, with button and card styles, a gallery, blog or shop page, light CSS and a video walkthrough for editing.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Send your logo in its original file format.
- Share two or three sites whose style you like.
- Prepare real photos, not placeholders.
- Choose the template based on your content, not only its homepage.

**Avoid:**
- Keeping demo sections you do not need.
- Mixing many fonts and colors.
- Switching templates mid-project without telling us.
- Using low-resolution images that look soft on large screens.

## Who this is for

A new freelancer wants a branded site this week without a designer's budget. A small studio with a clear logo and photos wants a clean portfolio. An owner who started a template and stalled wants someone to finish it properly.

## What we need from you

Share your brand files, your page text and your images. We never ask for a password. Create or open your Squarespace account and invite us as a contributor with permission to edit pages and styles, and tell us if you already have a template in mind. Template and plan costs are paid to Squarespace directly, and our price covers only our work.
